description: This file defines the Image_Graph_Marker class, a component for marking data points on a graph with visual labels or icons, as part of the PEAR Image_Graph package. It includes methods for setting size, secondary markers, and drawing the marker.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker
classes.description: A class for representing markers used to annotate data points on a graph, supporting secondary markers and customizable size.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the marker, with meaning depending on specific implementation.

methods.name: setSecondaryMarker
methods.description: Assigns a secondary marker object and sets its parent to this marker.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws the marker at specified (x, y) position, optionally with data values.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Indicates completion of drawing, returns true.
